mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which triggers a sell-off in equity markets, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect (as measured by a two-factor regression) has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), a rise in the federal funds rate compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS rise), or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO increases, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 800 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is negative over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When job growth (PAYEMS) slows and unemployment (UNRATE) rises simultaneously, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer confidence and spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of periods where PAYEMS growth slows and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term in a regression model has a positive coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 growth > 3.0% annualized), a decline in retail sales (RSAFS) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (GDPC1 > 3.0% and RSAFS decline), or the Rank IC is negative over any 1-year rolling window.
